Consent to Participate

What you will do

You will view a short Instagram-style feed, then answer a few brief questions. Please read the posts as you normally do.

Risks

There is minimal risk. Some content mentions health topics. You may stop at any time by closing the survey; however, payment is provided only for completed submissions. There is no other penalty for stopping early.

Privacy

We collect your survey responses and your Pure Spectrum participant ID. We do not collect your name or contact information. Data will be stored securely and reported only in aggregate.

Voluntary Participation

Participation is voluntary.

Consent

By selecting “I agree,” you confirm that you are 18 years or older and consent to participate.
